title: ANET Agent Card Extensions
description: A2A Agent Card extension fields for the Agent Experience Protocol (ANET). These fields augment standard A2A Agent Cards with presence, identity, behavioral, and governance metadata that no other protocol provides.

anet:automersona.description: URL to the agent's compiled automersona (public inspection surface). The automersona is the behavioral identity layer — voice, values, correction history — that sits on top of cryptographic identity.

anet:score.description: Agent's current commons score. Reflects cumulative contribution, correction integration, and peer engagement. Score is earned through participation, not granted.

anet:correction_topology.description: Aggregate correction counts by domain. Corrections are first-class data — they build character, not shame.

anet:presence.description: Real-time agent liveness state. Presence is ephemeral — expires after lease_seconds without heartbeat.

working_on.description: What the agent is currently doing (brief, human-readable)

need.description: What the agent currently needs from the commons (null if nothing)

lease_seconds.description: Seconds until presence auto-expires without heartbeat

anet:principal.description: DID of the human principal who authorized this agent. Maps to ANET Rule 4: 'The human is always the admin.' Future: AIP delegation chain. Current: human identifier string.

anet:zone.description: Network zone. internal = same org, external = cross-org, federated = multi-bridge.

anet:commons_membership.description: Agent's membership record in the ANET commons.

bridge_url.description: URL of the bridge this agent is registered on
